read_sql: SELECT m.id AS cursor, m.role AS role, m.content AS content, m.created_at AS timestamp, a.slug AS agent, COALESCE(w.path,'') AS workspace, c.id AS session, c.source_path || ':' || m.idx AS provenance FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id JOIN agents a ON a.id=c.agent_id LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=c.workspace_id
nullable_note: workspace 可空（~0.05% conversation 无 workspace_id），故不入 required_aliases；蒸馏桥过滤时容忍 workspace 空
